support_claim: The billing entity Oakfield Logistik GmbH is the post-rebrand name of Oakfield Logistics GmbH, the MSA-OAK-2018 counterparty, with unchanged Handelsregister number HRB 88421 establishing identity.

steps.fact: The left referent billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH denotes the legal counterparty billed as Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Oakfield Logistics GmbH rebranded to Oakfield Logistik GmbH in 2023; Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change.
HRB 88421 is registered to Oakfield Logistik GmbH.
Contract MSA-OAK-2018 names Oakfield Logistics GmbH as counterparty.

Because HRB 88421 did not change across the rebranding, Oakfield Logistics GmbH and Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal entity; therefore the billing counterparty and the MSA-OAK-2018 contract counterparty denote the same legal counterparty.
